{{Short description|German climate scientist}}
[[File:Hartmut Graßl.JPG|thumb|Hartmut Graßl (2010)]]
'''Hartmut Graßl''' (born 18 March 1940)<ref name="GmbH">{{cite web | title=Hartmut Graßl | website=Munzinger Biographie | url=https://www.munzinger.de/search/portrait/Hartmut%20Graßl/0/20408.html | language=de | access-date=14 October 2021}}</ref> is a German [[climate scientist]] and a former director of the [[Max Planck Institute for Meteorology]].

Born in Salzberg, near [[Berchtesgaden]],<ref name="GmbH" /> Graßl studied physics and meteorology at [[LMU Munich]], and earned his PhD there in 1970. In 1981, he became professor of theoretical meteorology at [[Kiel University]], and in 1984, he became director of the Institute of Physics at the GKSS Research Centre. In 1988, he became professor at the [[University of Hamburg]] and director of the [[Max Planck Institute for Meteorology]].<ref name="iflos">{{cite web |title=Professor Dr. Hartmut Graßl |url=https://www.iflos.org/faculty/professor-hartmut-grassl/ |website=International Foundation for the Law of the Sea |access-date=13 October 2021}}</ref><ref name="ae">{{cite web |title=Hartmut Graßl |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Grassl_Hartmut |publisher=[[Academia Europaea]] |access-date=13 October 2021}}</ref><ref name="dbu">{{cite web |title=Hartmut Graßl |url=https://www.deutscheumweltstiftung.de/profiles/prof-dr-hartmut-grassl/ |publisher=Deutsche Umweltstiftung |access-date=13 October 2021}}</ref><ref name="mpi 2020">{{cite web | title=Das MPI-M gratuliert Hartmut Graßl zum 80. Geburtstag | website=mpimet | date=18 March 2020 | url=https://mpimet.mpg.de/kommunikation/aktuelles/single-news/das-mpi-m-gratuliert-hartmut-grassl-zum-80-geburtstag | language=de | access-date=14 October 2021}}</ref> He retired in 2005.<ref name="DeutschesSchauSpielHausHamburg">{{cite web | title=Prof. Dr. Hartmut Graßl | website=DeutschesSchauSpielHausHamburg | url=http://schauspielhaus.de/de_DE/ensemble/prof_dr_hartmut_grassl.103387 | language=de | access-date=14 October 2021}}</ref>

==Honours==
* Young Scientist Award of the {{ill|German Meteorological Society|de|Deutsche Meteorologische Gesellschaft}}, 1971<ref name="iflos" />
* Scientific Member of the [[Max Planck Society]], 1988<ref name="iflos" />
* {{ill|Max Planck Prize|de|Max-Planck-Forschungspreis}}, 1991<ref name="dbu" />
* Member of the [[Academia Europaea]], 1994<ref name="ae" />
* [[German Environmental Prize]], 1998<ref name="dbu" /><ref name="DBU">{{cite web | title=Deutscher Umweltpreis 1998 – Prof. Dr. Klaus Ferdinand Hasselmann – Stichwort: Klimamodelle entwickeln – Deutscher Umweltpreis | website=DBU | url=https://www.dbu.de/123artikel2198_2418.html | language=de | access-date=14 October 2021}}</ref>
* Great Cross of Merit of the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]], 2002<ref name="dbu" />
* [[Bavarian Order of Merit]], 2008<ref name="dbu" />
